queue.tree_name: The Three Atlas Cedars of Préfargier
queue.recognise: Three Atlas cedars on one open lawn beside a gravel path, their crowns joined into one broad pyramid of blue-green needles, with a bench under the nearest trunk.
queue.story:
Three Atlas cedars stand together on one lawn in the park of the Préfargier estate, in the commune of La Tène, canton of Neuchâtel. A reader sent us their photograph and put it in one line, “3 cèdres de l’Atlas, dans le park du domaine de la maison de santé de Préfargier.”

The photograph shows why it was worth a picture. Three separate trunks rise a few metres apart and their crowns have grown into a single dark, broad pyramid, with silvery blue-green needles at the branch tips, the colour the Atlas cedar, Cedrus atlantica, is known for.
